newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Rain, absenteeism delay unloading at Colombo port.
newsitem.headline: Rain, absenteeism delay unloading at Colombo port.

text.p: Heavy rain and absenteeism after new year holidays have delayed the unloading of general cargo ships at Colombo port, a harbour official said on Friday.
"There are seven general cargo ships, including four sugar ships, waiting outside," he said. "Three of the sugar ships will berth by Saturday."

Twelve of the 25 ships in the outer harbour were waiting for bunkering, repairs or orders from principles, he said. The rest were mostly container feeder ships waiting for main line vessels with transshipment containers.
Recent rain and absenteeism after the April 13-14 Tamil and Sinhala new year holiday had delayed unloading, the official said.
